audit.summary: Archived assessment: Minor. Lorentz estimate uses the boundary dimension; Signed averaging destroys the lower norm equivalence; Harnack lower comparison omits a sign assumption
limitations: M25-0287-P1 — Lorentz estimate uses the boundary dimension — Counterevidence: Pinned TeX confirms n/2 and n, excluding extraction error. The counterexample does not invalidate existence for bounded compact data.

M25-0287-P2 — Signed averaging destroys the lower norm equivalence — Counterevidence: For nonnegative coordinates, bounded overlap gives u_Q<=C F(u); for all signs |F(u)|<=F(|u|) retains the upper bounds. Replacing signed coordinates by absolute values cannot justify a lower bound for the original signed averaging map.

M25-0287-P3 — Harnack lower comparison omits a sign assumption — Counterevidence: The upper local boundedness/Hölder assertions are not refuted. Fixed sign is a necessary restriction for the Harnack part, not a certification of every displayed radius/exponent after adding that restriction.
